title: Sequential Monte Carlo for Network Resilience Assessment and Control
summary: Resilience is emerging as a key requirement for next-generation wireless communication systems, requiring the ability to assess and control rare, path-dependent failure events arising from sequential degradation and delayed recovery. In this work, we develop a sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) framework for resilience assessment and control in networked systems. Resilience failures are formulated as staged, path-dependent events and represented through a reaction-coordinate-based decomposition that captures the progression toward non-recovery.
